item.title: Low-dose hydrocortisone may improve memory in women with HIV
item.description: A study found that low-dose hydrocortisone is well tolerated and enhances verbal learning, memory, working memory, and attention in adult women with HIV.

item.title: Six-month community program improves attention and diet in older adults
item.description: With aging populations increasing global healthcare demands, scalable prevention of cognitive decline is a priority. A six-month community program improved attention and diet scores in older adults.

item.title: Focal therapy remains uncommon in nonmetastatic prostate cancer
item.description: Focal therapy use is still rare across risk groups for nonmetastatic prostate cancer, and its application was often deemed inappropriate in clinical practice.

item.title: Self-control matures later than working memory in adolescence
item.description: Adolescence involves significant mental, emotional, and social changes. A large analysis found that self-control develops later than working memory during this period.
